sum: Cizzle Brands Corporation manufactures health, wellness, and nutrition consumer-packaged goods products in North America. The company produces and retails products through its CWENCH Hydration, Spoken Nutrition, and HappiEats brands. Its CWENCH Hydration is a sugar-free sports hydration drink with electrolytes, offered as a powder mix in individual sachets and larger serving containers, as well as ready-to-drink Tetra Paks, in flavors including Berry Crush, Blue Raspberry, Cherry Lime, Rainbow Swirl, Tropical Flow, Celly Freeze, Pink Lemon Flow, Rocket Berry Blast, and PowerPlay Punch. The company also offers CWENCH Protein, a nutraceutical product. Its Spoken Nutrition products consist of nutritional supplements, and its HappiEats products comprise Sport Pasta and SnakStars Sport Bites. The company also provides contract and toll co-manufacturing and production services for beverages in Tetra Pak format for both its proprietary brands and third-party brands serving Canadian and United States customers. It distributes products to sports and specialty retailers, grocery stores, gas and convenience stores, and sports and fitness venues such as hockey arenas, fitness centers, and training facilities across North America and Europe; and retails products through retail channels, websites, and e-commerce platforms. Cizzle Brands Corporation was formerly known as 1348512 B.C. Ltd. and changed its name to Cizzle Brands Corporation in December 2024. Cizzle Brands Corporation was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Concord, Canada.
ceo: Mr. John  Celenza (Founder, CEO, Chairman & Corporate Secretary)
